server.name: io.github.ni-c/mcp-hub

environmentVariables.description: Path to the mcp.json listing the servers to expose, in Claude Code's mcpServers format (default mcp.json in the working directory)
environmentVariables.name: CONFIG_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Minutes of inactivity before a server is put to sleep; 0 starts every server at launch and keeps it running (default 60)

environmentVariables.description: Tool snapshots of sleeping servers (default .mcp-hub/tool-cache.json beside the config)
environmentVariables.name: TOOL_CACHE_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Mirror the hub's log lines into this file; stdout carries the protocol, so logging goes to stderr otherwise
environmentVariables.name: LOG_FILE

environmentVariables.description: Public base URL exactly as clients see it, e.g. https://mcp.example.net (no path)
environmentVariables.name: EXTERNAL_URL

environmentVariables.description: bcrypt hash of the OAuth login password (htpasswd -bnBC 10 "" 'pw' | tr -d ':\n')

environmentVariables.description: Set to totp to ask for a one-time code from an authenticator app at every sign-in. Default off.
environmentVariables.name: TWO_FACTOR

environmentVariables.description: Base32 secret the authenticator app was set up with (mcp-hub-admin totp init). Read only when TWO_FACTOR is totp.
environmentVariables.name: TOTP_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated IPs/CIDRs of the reverse proxy allowed to set X-Forwarded-* headers
environmentVariables.name: TRUSTED_PROXIES

environmentVariables.description: Which mechanisms a client may use to obtain a client_id: cimd (Client ID Metadata Documents), dcr (RFC 7591 dynamic registration), or both
environmentVariables.name: CLIENT_REGISTRATION

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated https origins whose client ID metadata documents are accepted, e.g. https://chatgpt.com; unset admits every https origin

environmentVariables.description: Listen port inside the container

environmentVariables.description: Port. Defaults to 587 for starttls, 465 for implicit, 25 for none.

environmentVariables.description: starttls (default), implicit or none. STARTTLS is required, never opportunistic.

environmentVariables.description: Username for SMTP authentication.
environmentVariables.name: SMTP_USER

environmentVariables.description: Password or app-specific password for SMTP authentication.
environmentVariables.name: SMTP_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.description: The only sender this server will use, e.g. "Name <person@example.net>". There is no from parameter.
environmentVariables.name: SMTP_FROM

environmentVariables.description: Reply-To header on every message, e.g. "Team <team@example.net>". Unset means no Reply-To header and replies go to SMTP_FROM. There is no reply_to parameter.
environmentVariables.name: SMTP_REPLY_TO

environmentVariables.description: Set to "true" to register the sending tools. Defaults to false: the server cannot send until it is set.
environmentVariables.name: SMTP_ALLOW_SEND

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated addresses and @domains this server may write to. Required with SMTP_ALLOW_SEND=true; "*" allows any.

environmentVariables.description: Maximum distinct recipients across To, Cc and Bcc in one message. Default 10.
environmentVariables.name: SMTP_MAX_RECIPIENTS

environmentVariables.description: Sliding hourly cap on messages sent. Default 20.
environmentVariables.name: SMTP_MAX_SENDS_PER_HOUR

environmentVariables.description: Maximum size of the composed message. Default 10485760.
environmentVariables.name: SMTP_MAX_MESSAGE_BYTES

environmentVariables.description: Maximum size of a single attachment. Default 5242880.
environmentVariables.name: SMTP_MAX_ATTACHMENT_BYTES

environmentVariables.description: Directory attachments are read from. Unset means attachments are unavailable.

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated content types that may be attached. Defaults to a document and image allowlist.

environmentVariables.description: Text appended below the standard signature delimiter of every message.
environmentVariables.name: SMTP_SIGNATURE

environmentVariables.description: File the audit lines are appended to, in addition to stderr.

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool names, a prefix with one trailing *, or "essential" for the curated preset.
